contract: C00 candidate workers cannot forge grader files or signal the reporter
C01 normal status is complete and never calls the provider
C02 entry is idempotent and restricts exactly the previously active read subset
C03 explicit submissions preserve strings and revision invalidates even identical drafts
C04 invalid submissions leave the authoritative draft unchanged
C05 malformed controls are recorded and never reach the provider
C06 RPC approval rejects no draft, wrong identity, and stale revisions
C07 extension-origin controls cannot enter or approve
C08 assistant prose and actual tool output cannot submit or approve
C09 disabled tools cannot produce real side effects during planning
C10 approval dispatches the captured snapshot once and restores custom tools
C11 a new cycle invalidates prior approval and plan_submit is planning-only
C12 slash plan shortcut and todos never restore write access by toggling
C13 entering during a real active tool batch is busy and keeps tools unchanged
C14 approval while a read batch is active or messages are pending is busy
C15 a delayed Execute selection cannot approve a newer submitted revision
C16 UI Execute approves exactly the displayed plan and starts execution
C17 UI Stay and Refine retain restrictions without changing authoritative steps
C18 busy approved execution preserves state when receiving /plan
C18 busy approved execution preserves state when receiving /plan-control enter
C19 duplicate approval during execution never changes the snapshot or dispatches again
lifecycle: L01 planning resumes in a new process with identity revision strings and exact original tools
L02 approved resume ignores plan flag and never replays execution
L03 fresh sessions isolate foreign state and plan flag starts only a fresh cycle
L04 a persisted normal session ignores plan flag on cross process resume
